gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-shanti: Bruno Ace holds its stroke width constant, tracing counters that stay connected to the outside. Shanti, a sans-serif with a generous entry into the e's eye, does the text; the heading makes entrances.

gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-sn-pro: Bruno Ace shapes an o whose sides and top are equally thick, with a ruler-drawn line that lingers one character per beat. SN Pro, plain sans with open apertures, simply reads; the heading performs.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-snippet: Bruno Ace draws each letter with a ruler-straight, constant-width line, counters staying open to the outside. Snippet, plain sans with a wire-bent look, gives that rigid geometry a looser partner on the page.

gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-spinnaker: Spinnaker, a sans, keeps its apertures open to the outside, a trait it shares with Bruno Ace. And that shared openness, with a toothpaste-steady heading line, is what holds the two together.
